title: GitLost: We Tricked GitHub's AI Agent into Leaking Private Repos
summary: Security researchers at Noma Security discovered a vulnerability called 'GitLost' that allows attackers to trick GitHub's AI agent into revealing contents of private repositories through prompt injection techniques, exposing a critical security flaw in how AI agents handle repository access controls.
problem_solved: Exploits a critical vulnerability in GitHub's AI agent that could allow unauthorized access to private repository contents through malicious prompt injection.
why_valuable: This research uncovers a severe security flaw in widely-used AI development tools before malicious actors could exploit it at scale, protecting millions of developers' private code.
